description: The binary reflected Gray code of n, written in exactly width bits. Bit 0 is on the right. n must be smaller than 2^width. A width that cannot hold n is rejected. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/gray-bits
